title: Chapter 493
paragraphs: Chapter 493
Episode 137. Everyone had good plans (4)
It wasn't just the aura. They could also feel the vast and high-purity magic power.
"It's a battle!"
As soon as Diphus spoke, the vibration grew stronger. And there was an explosion near the middle floor of the Tower of White Night, with a flash of light.
It was a type of explosion the group had seen countless times in their lives.
The spectacular light that did not appear in battles between knights or magicians continued to illuminate the area around the Tower of White Night.
"It's not a fight between Kinzelo and Zipple."
Although it wasn't something to be proud of, the three brothers of Runcandel who had come here had all learned the same sword.
"It's Joshua. He and the Black Knight have started a battle with Zipple's magicians."
Without seeing it directly, Jin and Diphus could precisely recognize the unique destructive aura of Runcandel's sword.
Additionally, the brothers recognized the owners of the magic power.
'Wraith Squad.'
The strongest magic unit of Zipple, which both had experienced firsthand. It was clear that they were fighting against Joshua.
"I don't know if they were discovered during infiltration or if it was a trap from the beginning that he fell into. I think it's the latter."
Either way, it was a difficult situation for the group.

'Judging by the scale, there don't seem to be many other magicians in the second tower, but since it's been revealed that Joshua and the Black Knight are in the second tower, support will come from Drakka!'
This is Zipple's headquarters.
There's no way they would be short of forces to send just enough support to the underground construction site in the Sota Desert.
Furthermore, the second tower was much more dangerous than the construction site.
The construction site was just a bait for resources to check the capabilities of external forces, but the real information, the blueprint of the ship, would be in the second tower.
'But... it's a bit strange. I can feel the magic power of about two or three Wraith Squad members, four at most. Why did they only deploy that many?'

If Zipple had anticipated an infiltration into the second tower and had set a trap to catch the biggest fish from external forces, then even with the risk of a full-scale battle, they would have tried to annihilate all of them.
Now was the best opportunity.
Not just two to four members of the Wraith Squad, but a much larger force should have been waiting in the Tower of White Night right in front of them.
It wouldn't have been strange if a person like Kelliark Zipple himself or Octavia had appeared.
But only a few members of the Wraith Squad were present.
'Is it not a trap?'
It was not easy to quickly grasp the situation before and after.
However, it was time to make a decision.

'If it's a blatant trap, it would be right to abandon the blueprint and escape. In that case, Zipple would not have left the blueprint in the second tower. Besides, even with Murakan and Diphus, we can't escape against Zipple with their full focus.'
But what if it's not a trap?

What if the reason only a few members of the Wraith Squad are guarding the Tower of White Night is due to a complicated mix of various cause-and-effect relationships that are difficult to calculate immediately, in other words, just Zipple's carelessness and mistake?
What if Joshua had already secured the blueprint, and the battle occurred during the escape process?
Jin's head felt like it was going to explode, as it had been since they arrived in the Sota Desert.
It was difficult to even estimate how many variables they had experienced so far and how many unexpected situations they would face in the future.
However, one thing was certain.
'If not today, the chance to obtain Zipple's airship blueprint will never come again.'
Just the fact that Runcandel had struck not only the construction site but also the second tower would lead Zipple to significantly strengthen security, regardless of the outcome of this incident.
They were not a family that would make the same mistake, especially being the number one in the world.
Soon, Jin came to a conclusion.
"…It doesn't seem to be a trap, second brother. If they had lured us in from the beginning, there would have been more forces."
"That's true. Ugh, it's driving me crazy. If it's not a trap, why did that stupid Joshua get caught and make us so anxious?"
Whoosh!
The middle floor of the second tower exploded again, and debris fell. The battle continued to intensify.
"It's a moment that requires adventure."
Jin took a deep breath and continued.
"Even if it's not a trap, support will arrive soon, so retreating would be a rational judgment. However, we can't rule out the possibility that Joshua has secured the blueprint."
Diphus nodded.
"I see what you mean."
"You can return now if you want, brother."
"Little brother, what are you talking about? Deciding to kill Joshua was an adventure from the beginning. Why would I think of backing out now?"
"I just thought I'd ask in case."

"Besides, this might be an opportunity. If he has the blueprint, we can just kill him and take it after he escapes from the battle. Joshua will definitely be injured in the fight against the Wraith Squad, so it might be easier to achieve both goals. Moreover, we won't be able to get the blueprint if it's not today, never."
Diphus had already been thinking the same as Jin.
As he said, the situation unfolding in that way would undoubtedly be the best development.
If they had known that the blueprint did not exist in the second tower vault, neither of them would have made such a judgment.
"Let's go, little brother, Lord Murakan. Let's save him and kill him ourselves before Zipple's reinforcements arrive."
Of course, Zipple's reinforcements were not the only issue to be aware of.
'It bothers me that Kinzelo, after the construction site terror, has not yet shown any significant prominence.'
Either they are moving slowly, hindered by barriers other than the ones Jin had removed, or they are still waiting for a better opportunity, even though the situation has unfolded this far.
He looked back for a moment. In the distant Sota Desert, battles between Kinzelo and Zipple were unfolding not only underground but also on the surface.
'It seems they're waiting for an opportunity. However, Kinzelo hasn't achieved what they wanted yet. If they had, the terrorists would have started to retreat.'
The three of them could reach the tower entrance in an instant.
Although debris and rubble from the middle floor where Joshua and the Wraith Squad were fighting were scattered around, no other magicians or guards were visible.
As they entered, the vast interior unfolded. Whether it was magically soundproofed or for some other reason, the noise and vibration from the battle were surprisingly not felt inside.
It also meant that the tower was very sturdy.
Even if it was a large building, it would have turned to dust as soon as Joshua and the Wraith Squad started fighting if it were a regular structure.
"Not a single bug. It's almost abandoned, isn't it?"
Murakan tilted his head and spoke. Jin and Diphus were also puzzled even after seeing it for themselves.
It was impossible to guess that the reason there was not a single person in the tower was solely due to Sandra Zipple's whims and madness.
There was a huge spiral staircase in the center. There was an elevator in the middle, but it was not working.
They ran up the stairs.
The tower was much taller than it looked from the outside. Even running at full speed, it didn't feel like the middle floor where Joshua and the Wraith Squad were located was getting closer quickly.
It meant that Jin and Diphus were that impatient. They were worried that the blueprint might be lost during the battle.
Fortunately, they soon felt the vibrations from the battle again. It was a signal that they had reached the middle floor.
They opened the magnificent iron door that was tightly closed.
Screech!
The Wraith Squad was indeed the Wraith Squad. While they were engaged in a fierce battle, they immediately fired a magic beam at Jin as soon as the door opened.
Kwagak-!
The beam was deflected by Diphus's sword, the sword-spirit of Bolgar.
The magicians of the Wraith Squad calmly adjusted their formation to face the increased number of enemies.
At that moment, Jin and Diphus couldn't help but grit their teeth.
'Damn, there are four of them.'
They had expected between two and four, but unfortunately, it was four. Joshua and Jane had been fighting four Wraith Squad members before Jin's group arrived.
Jin's group approached Joshua. He was a little out of breath, but not severely injured.
The problem was with the Black Knight, Jane.

She wasn't critically injured, but her significant blood loss from various large and small wounds all over her body was concerning. Several wounds appeared deep enough to be life-threatening at any moment.
Facing four Wraith Squad members would be life-threatening even for a Black Knight, let alone a 2-on-2.
Moreover, this was Zipple's territory, inside the tower.
It was entirely possible that the Wraith Squad was using even more powerful magic than usual by utilizing the tower's special devices or energies.
Jane's injuries were undoubtedly sustained while protecting Joshua.
Of course, as a Black Knight, it's natural to protect the heir of the family, but the current Joshua was not his true self.
'Does the Black Knight not know that the current Joshua is a clone? Damn it. The family's best talent was being sacrificed to protect a mere clone.'
He felt like cutting off the neck immediately. The neck of the true self, not the clone.
However, Jin did not miss one crucial fact.

'Joshua hasn't obtained the blueprint yet. No matter how despicable he is, my second brother's assessment wasn't entirely wrong. If he had obtained it, he would have somehow blocked this place and told the Black Knight to escape with the blueprint.'
Although hidden behind a mask, Joshua must have been wearing a bewildered yet happy expression.
His monopoly on information about the second tower had been exposed, Jin's group arrived sooner than expected, and yet, thanks to them, the situation could be turned around.
"4th Rank, 12th Rank."
"Hey, but this guy doesn't greet me again? Hey, can't you see me? Huh? Do I need to poke your eyes?"
"…And Lord Murakan. We'll explain the situation later…"
"No need, 2nd Rank."
Jin interrupted Joshua's words and drew his sword.

"Instead, tell me the location of the blueprint immediately. If you refuse, I'll warn you that I have the authority to execute you on the spot for obstructing the mission. You should know that I don't bluff."
